sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受nytimes.com/subscribe上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: Well, I've been waiting this moment for 15 months.
sentences.zh: 我等这一刻已经等了15个月了。

sentences.en: Finally, I cannot hear any drones.
sentences.zh: 终于，我听不到任何无人机的声音了。

sentences.en: For 15 months, I've been away from seeing my daughters.
sentences.zh: 这15个月来，我一直没能见到我的女儿们。

sentences.en: I'll be happy when I'm returning to North Gaza.
sentences.zh: 当我回到加沙北部时，我会很高兴的。

sentences.en: I know it's completely destroyed, but still, I want to go there.
sentences.zh: 我知道那里已经彻底被毁了，但即便如此，我还是想去那里。

sentences.en: I want to go to see my daughters, to hug them, to feel like they are still alive.
sentences.zh: 我想去见我的女儿们，拥抱她们，感受她们还活着。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: And this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: After more than a year of war, Israel and Hamas have agreed to a temporary ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 经过一年多的战争，以色列和哈马斯已同意临时停火。

sentences.en: Relief, I guess, would be the first reaction.
sentences.zh: 我想，第一反应应该是如释重负。

sentences.en: I'll be relieved when the hostages are back in Israel.
sentences.zh: 当人质回到以色列时，我才会感到如释重负。

sentences.en: That's when I'll be relieved.
sentences.zh: 到那时我才会感到解脱。

sentences.en: It prompted hope that the war could soon end.
sentences.zh: 这引发了战争可能很快结束的希望。

sentences.en: I am still worried, afraid of the implementation of the ceasefire agreement.
sentences.zh: 我仍然很担心，害怕停火协议无法落实。

sentences.en: But also worry that the tentative terms could easily fall apart.
sentences.zh: 但也担心这些初步条款很容易破裂。

sentences.en: I don't know what will happen next.
sentences.zh: 我不知道接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Patrick Kingsley on why the agreement finally happened and what it means for Gaza, Israel, and the broader Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事帕特里克·金斯利将探讨为什么该协议最终达成，以及它对加沙、以色列和更广泛的中东地区意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, January 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月16日，星期四。

sentences.en: Patrick, you've been covering this war since the very start.
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，你从战争一开始就一直在报道这件事。

sentences.en: In fact, we've had you on so many times to explain to us the developments, to really educate us about what's going on there.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们已经多次邀请你来为我们解释事态发展，让我们真正了解那里正在发生什么。

sentences.en: And after many failed attempts at a ceasefire, one has finally been agreed on.
sentences.zh: 在多次停火尝试失败后，终于达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: We're speaking on Wednesday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我们是在周三下午进行这次谈话的。

sentences.en: So far, what do we know about what it says?
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我们对协议内容了解多少？

sentences.en: In essence, it's a three-stage ceasefire that could, if all goes well, end up being a permanent truce.
sentences.zh: 本质上，这是一个三阶段的停火协议，如果一切顺利，最终可能成为永久停火。

sentences.en: The first phase is the only part of the deal that is really nailed down.
sentences.zh: 第一阶段是协议中唯一真正敲定的部分。

sentences.en: That's a six-week phase, during which 33 hostages, mostly alive, but some of them dead, are set to be released by Hamas and its allies,
sentences.zh: 这是一个为期六周的阶段，期间33名人质（大部分还活着，但也有一些已经死亡）将由哈马斯及其盟友释放，

sentences.en: who captured those hostages right at the start of the war on October 7th, 2023.
sentences.zh: 他们是在2023年10月7日战争刚开始时俘虏了这些人质的。

sentences.en: And in exchange, Israel is supposed to release several hundred Palestinian prisoners from Israeli jails.
sentences.zh: 作为交换，以色列应该从以色列监狱中释放数百名巴勒斯坦囚犯。

sentences.en: And during that six weeks, we also expect Israeli troops to gradually withdraw,
sentences.zh: 在这六周期间，我们还预计以色列军队将逐步撤出，

sentences.en: allowing several hundred thousand Palestinians who were displaced from their homes in northern Gaza to tents and makeshift camps in the south of the Strip to return to their homes,
sentences.zh: 让数十万从加沙北部家园流离失所、住在加沙地带南部帐篷和临时营地的巴勒斯坦人能够回到自己的家园，

sentences.en: to move back northward to a decimated Gaza city.
sentences.zh: 搬回满目疮痍的加沙城。

sentences.en: During all of that movement and exchanges of captives, there will be more negotiations to see if they can extend this initial six-week phase into another six-week phase,
sentences.zh: 在所有这些人员流动和俘虏交换期间，还将进行更多谈判，看看能否将最初的六周阶段延长至另一个六周阶段，

sentences.en: during which the deal is supposed to become permanent and more hostages are supposed to be released for more prisoners.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，该协议应成为永久性的，并且预计会有更多人质被释放以换取更多囚犯。

sentences.en: The problem is there is still much to be negotiated about that second phase.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，关于第二阶段还有很多需要谈判的地方。

sentences.en: And Patrick, what still remains to be negotiated exactly?
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，到底还有什么需要谈判的？

sentences.en: There seems to be still some disagreement about where exactly Israel will withdraw from.
sentences.zh: 关于以色列具体从哪里撤军，似乎仍存在一些分歧。

sentences.en: And there's enough ambiguity in there that the deal could collapse after six weeks, if not before.
sentences.zh: 而且其中存在足够的模糊性，如果不是更早的话，协议可能会在六周后崩溃。

sentences.en: And that ambiguity is intentional.
sentences.zh: 这种模糊性是故意的。

sentences.en: Israel, and first and foremost, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, did not want to agree to a deal that would definitively end the war.
sentences.zh: 以色列，尤其是总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡，不想同意一项会彻底结束战争的协议。

sentences.en: Hamas had the opposite perspective.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯的观点则相反。

sentences.en: They wanted a deal that would end the war for certain.
sentences.zh: 他们想要一项肯定能结束战争的协议。

sentences.en: And so the mediators between the two sides came up with ambiguous wording that would allow each side to feel like they were getting more or less what they want.
sentences.zh: 因此，双方之间的调解人提出了模糊的措辞，让双方都觉得他们或多或少得到了他们想要的东西。

sentences.en: The wording allows Israel to say that they can break the arrangement after six weeks, and it provides the possibility for Hamas
sentences.zh: 这些措辞允许以色列声称他们可以在六周后终止安排，同时也为哈马斯提供了可能性，

sentences.en: that the ceasefire will extend beyond 42 days into something permanent, and that they will be able to survive the war intact as a group
sentences.zh: 即停火将延长至42天之后，变成永久性的，并且他们作为一个组织能够完整地在战争中幸存下来，

sentences.en: and in power as the governing force over Gaza.
sentences.zh: 并作为加沙的执政力量继续掌权。

sentences.en: Patrick, you've talked through two phases.
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，你已经谈到了两个阶段。

sentences.en: What's the third phase?
sentences.zh: 第三阶段是什么？

sentences.en: The third phase would not be significantly different from the second phase, but there would be final exchanges of dead bodies and other human remains,
sentences.zh: 第三阶段与第二阶段没有太大区别，但会有最终的尸体和其他人类遗骸的交换，

sentences.en: as well as the start of a massive reconstruction project to rebuild the Gaza Strip over several years.
sentences.zh: 以及启动一项大规模的重建项目，在几年内重建加沙地带。

sentences.en: So why, after all these months, is this ceasefire finally happening now?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么在经历了这么多月之后，这次停火终于在现在发生了？

sentences.en: I think there's several factors here.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里有几个因素。

sentences.en: One, Israel is stronger.
sentences.zh: 第一，以色列更强大了。

sentences.en: Two, Hamas is weaker.
sentences.zh: 第二，哈马斯更弱了。

sentences.en: And three, the Trump administration is about to come into power and has put pressure on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, the Israeli leader.
sentences.zh: 第三，特朗普政府即将上台，并向以色列领导人本雅明·内塔尼亚胡总理施加了压力。

sentences.en: Yeah, so let's dig into each of those points then.
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们来深入探讨一下这几点。

sentences.en: Why don't you start with Israel stronger?
sentences.zh: 为什么不从以色列更强大这一点开始呢？

sentences.en: Since last summer, Israel has had a series of military successes.
sentences.zh: 自去年夏天以来，以色列取得了一系列军事成功。

sentences.en: It has most obviously weakened Hamas,
sentences.zh: 最明显的是，它削弱了哈马斯，

sentences.en: taken over more of the Gaza Strip, destroyed more of Hamas's infrastructure, killed more Hamas leaders, including Yahya Sinwar,
sentences.zh: 占领了加沙地带更多地区，摧毁了哈马斯更多的基础设施，击毙了更多哈马斯领导人，包括叶海亚·辛瓦尔，

sentences.en: the man who did more than anyone to mastermind the October 7th attack on Israel at the start of the war.
sentences.zh: 那个在战争初期策划了10月7日对以色列袭击的人。

sentences.en: Further afield, Israel has substantially weakened Hezbollah, a key ally of Hamas in Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 在更远的地方，以色列实质上削弱了哈马斯在黎巴嫩的关键盟友真主党。

sentences.en: It has weakened Hamas's main benefactor, Iran, destroying much of its air defences.
sentences.zh: 它削弱了哈马斯的主要支持者伊朗，摧毁了其大部分防空系统。

sentences.en: And another member of the Iran-led alliance, the Syrian government, has collapsed.
sentences.zh: 而伊朗领导的联盟的另一个成员，叙利亚政府，已经垮台了。

sentences.en: So Prime Minister Netanyahu can present more or less the same deal to the Israeli public, and in particular to his far-right allies, as being less of a capitulation,
sentences.zh: 因此，内塔尼亚胡总理可以向以色列公众，特别是向他的极右翼盟友，提出大致相同的协议，并将其描述为不那么像投降，

sentences.en: as it was once seen by parts of his coalition government.
sentences.zh: 正如他联合政府中的部分人曾经认为的那样。

sentences.en: Because he and Israel are coming from a position of greater military strength.
sentences.zh: 因为他和以色列正处于军事实力更强的地位。

sentences.en: And the flip side is that Hamas is therefore weaker.
sentences.zh: 而另一面是哈马斯因此变得更弱了。

sentences.en: Gaza is decimated.
sentences.zh: 加沙已成废墟。

sentences.en: Hamas's goal of setting off a kind of broader regional conflict that would substantially weaken Israel or perhaps even destroy it has come to nothing.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯试图引发一场更广泛的地区冲突，从而实质性削弱甚至摧毁以色列的目标已经化为泡影。

sentences.en: And the going analysis is that this has made Hamas more willing to come to the table and agree to a deal that was on that table already for several months.
sentences.zh: 目前的分析是，这使得哈马斯更愿意坐到谈判桌前，同意一项已经在桌面上摆了几个月的协议。

sentences.en: And the third factor is the Trump factor.
sentences.zh: 第三个因素是特朗普因素。

sentences.en: It's the Biden administration, in tandem with the Qatari government and the Egyptian government, that has done most of the running in the negotiations,
sentences.zh: 是拜登政府，与卡塔尔政府和埃及政府一道，在谈判中做了大部分工作，

sentences.en: helping to draft the details of this agreement that has just been signed and cajoling the Israeli government for more than a year towards this agreement.
sentences.zh: 帮助起草了刚刚签署的这项协议的细节，并在一年多来不断敦促以色列政府达成这项协议。

sentences.en: But it seems to be the incoming Trump administration,
sentences.zh: 但似乎是即将上任的特朗普政府，

sentences.en: President-elect Trump himself, and his incoming Middle East envoy, Steve Witkoff, that have applied the pressure that has been the straw that broke the camel's back.
sentences.zh: 当选总统特朗普本人，以及他即将上任的中东特使史蒂夫·威特科夫，施加了压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草。

sentences.en: Steve Witkoff came to Israel last week, met with Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·威特科夫上周来到以色列，会见了内塔尼亚胡。

sentences.en: Who, since that meeting, the negotiations have gone from advancing fairly slowly to suddenly getting to the point of a deal being reached.
sentences.zh: 自那次会议以来，谈判从进展缓慢突然变成了达成协议。

sentences.en: And it seems to be that Trump, who has said for months that he wants to see a deal by the time of his inauguration early next week, may have been a decisive factor
sentences.zh: 看来特朗普可能是一个决定性因素，他几个月来一直说希望在下周初就职时看到协议达成，

sentences.en: in getting this deal over the line.
sentences.zh: 从而促成了这项协议。

sentences.en: And what exactly did Witkoff say?
sentences.zh: 威特科夫到底说了什么？

sentences.en: I mean, how did he put pressure on Netanyahu that may have kind of really moved it for the Israelis here?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他是如何向内塔尼亚胡施压，从而真正推动以色列人达成协议的？

sentences.en: We weren't inside the room, so we can't say for sure, but it's possible that it was some combination of carrot and stick.
sentences.zh: 我们不在房间里，所以不能确定，但可能是胡萝卜加大棒的结合。

sentences.en: The stick being that Trump, who's an unpredictable actor, would be very angry if a deal wasn't reached.
sentences.zh: 大棒是特朗普，一个不可预测的行动者，如果达不成协议会非常生气。

sentences.en: The carrot may be that the Trump administration will back Netanyahu if he decides to resume the war after six weeks.
sentences.zh: 胡萝卜可能是，如果内塔尼亚胡决定在六周后恢复战争，特朗普政府会支持他。

sentences.en: That was less likely under President Biden, but it's seen as being potentially more likely under a Trump administration who might grant greater leeway to Israel in Gaza
sentences.zh: 在拜登总统任内这不太可能，但在特朗普政府下，这被认为更有可能，因为他可能会在加沙给予以色列更大的回旋余地，

sentences.en: than President Biden.
sentences.zh: 超过拜登总统。

sentences.en: The reverse could also be true.
sentences.zh: 反之亦然。

sentences.en: Having helped to author this deal, the Trump administration may see its reputation as being tied to its success and may place more pressure on Netanyahu in several weeks.
sentences.zh: 在帮助促成这项协议后，特朗普政府可能会认为其声誉与协议的成功息息相关，并可能在几周后对内塔尼亚胡施加更多压力。

sentences.en: And we await to see which of those two outcomes will be the case.
sentences.zh: 我们拭目以待这两种结果中哪一种会成为现实。

sentences.en: So is the Trump envoy working directly with the Biden people on this?
sentences.zh: 那么特朗普的特使是在这方面直接与拜登的人合作吗？

sentences.en: That's been one of the more remarkable aspects of the recent days of negotiations.
sentences.zh: 这是最近几天谈判中比较引人注目的方面之一。

sentences.en: You've had representatives of two administrations that really don't see eye to eye and have very different visions of American democracy
sentences.zh: 你有两个政府的代表，他们真的意见不合，对美国民主有着非常不同的愿景，

sentences.en: joining forces to get this deal over the line.
sentences.zh: 却联手促成了这项协议。

sentences.en: The Biden administration that has led the way in drafting and wrangling over many of the details over so many months in these negotiations, it's Trump's Middle East envoy
sentences.zh: 拜登政府在这些谈判中花费数月时间主导了许多细节的起草和争论，而特朗普的中东特使

sentences.en: who appears to have played a major role in getting this deal suddenly over the line in recent days.
sentences.zh: 似乎在最近几天促成这项协议突然达成方面发挥了重要作用。

sentences.en: So those are the mechanics of the deal.
sentences.zh: 所以这些就是协议的运作机制。

sentences.en: And we are left with questions about how exactly those mechanics will play out.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然对这些机制将如何具体发挥作用存有疑问。

sentences.en: And we're also left with questions about what all this means in the long term for Israelis, for Palestinians in Gaza, in the West Bank, and also for the region,
sentences.zh: 我们也对这一切从长远来看对以色列人、对加沙和西岸的巴勒斯坦人，以及对整个地区意味着什么存有疑问，

sentences.en: the Middle East as a whole.
sentences.zh: 即整个中东地区。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图之一，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往nytimes.com/games立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So Patrick, how should we understand this deal and what it means for Gazans, for Hamas, for Israel, and really for the world?
sentences.zh: 那么帕特里克，我们应该如何理解这项协议，以及它对加沙人、哈马斯、以色列，乃至对世界意味着什么？

sentences.en: For Gazans, it is, at least for a few weeks,
sentences.zh: 对于加沙人来说，这至少在几周内，

sentences.en: respite from one of the most intense aerial campaigns and ground invasions, certainly in the history of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, but also in 21st century warfare.
sentences.zh: 是自以色列-巴勒斯坦冲突史上，甚至21世纪战争史上最激烈的空中战役和地面入侵之一中的喘息机会。

sentences.en: And even if this deal collapses after six weeks, it gives them the opportunity to have a night's sleep without bombardment.
sentences.zh: 即使这项协议在六周后崩溃，它也给了他们一个晚上不用遭受轰炸而安睡的机会。

sentences.en: It gives people a chance to find their loved ones whose corpses have been trapped on the rubble for months, in some cases over a year.
sentences.zh: 它给了人们一个机会去寻找那些尸体被困在瓦砾下数月，在某些情况下甚至超过一年的亲人。

sentences.en: It gives hundreds of thousands of Palestinians in southern Gaza the ability to finally, after more than a year of displacement, return home to northern Gaza.
sentences.zh: 它让加沙南部的数十万巴勒斯坦人在流离失所一年多后，终于能够回到加沙北部的家园。

sentences.en: Scores of universities, hospitals, medical centers have been destroyed during this war, and it could even take decades to repair some of that damage.
sentences.zh: 在这场战争中，大量的大学、医院、医疗中心被毁，修复其中一些损失甚至可能需要几十年。

sentences.en: And Patrick, who will do all of that rebuilding?
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，谁来做所有这些重建工作？

sentences.en: So, Hamas as a movement, and the Hamas-controlled Gazan authorities don't really have the ability to do much of this on their own.
sentences.zh: 所以，哈马斯作为一个运动，以及哈马斯控制的加沙当局，其实没有能力独自完成大部分工作。

sentences.en: They're going to rely on massive overseas help from the rest of the Arab world, from the United Nations, and exactly how that is going to work has not yet been decided.
sentences.zh: 他们将依赖来自阿拉伯世界其他地区、联合国的巨额海外援助，而这具体将如何运作尚未决定。

sentences.en: And Patrick, what about Hamas in the context of this deal?
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，在协议的背景下，哈马斯的情况如何？

sentences.en: What does the deal mean for that group?
sentences.zh: 这项协议对该组织意味着什么？

sentences.en: The deal gives them the chance of survival.
sentences.zh: 这项协议给了他们生存的机会。

sentences.en: As the war went on, they were losing more troops, more operatives, more leaders.
sentences.zh: 随着战争的进行，他们失去了更多的士兵、更多的特工、更多的领导人。

sentences.en: Their top leader, Yahya Sinwar, was killed, if you recall, in October.
sentences.zh: 如果你还记得的话，他们的最高领导人叶海亚·辛瓦尔在10月被击毙。

sentences.en: Sinwar's predecessor, Ismail Haniyeh, was killed also in the summer.
sentences.zh: 辛瓦尔的前任伊斯梅尔·哈尼亚也在夏天被杀。

sentences.en: Now that the war has stopped, at least for now, and there's a possibility that the initial six-week ceasefire will extend into something longer, they may be able to survive the war
sentences.zh: 现在战争已经停止，至少暂时停止了，而且最初的六周停火有可能延长为更长的时间，他们可能能够在战争中幸存下来，

sentences.en: both intact as a movement and in power as a governing force in the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 既作为一个运动保持完整，又作为加沙地带的执政力量继续掌权。

sentences.en: Which is pretty remarkable, given where we started, which was Israel saying that Hamas would be eliminated from the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 这相当了不起，考虑到我们开始时的情况，即以色列声称哈马斯将被从加沙地带清除。

sentences.en: They said words to that effect.
sentences.zh: 他们说了类似的话。

sentences.en: After the October 7th raid by Hamas and its allies,
sentences.zh: 在哈马斯及其盟友10月7日的突袭之后，

sentences.en: Israel basically said its two goals of the war would be to return the hostages captured by Hamas and its allies on October 7th, and to destroy Hamas's military capabilities
sentences.zh: 以色列基本上表示其战争的两个目标是归还哈马斯及其盟友在10月7日俘虏的人质，并摧毁哈马斯的军事能力

sentences.en: and its governing capabilities.
sentences.zh: 及其治理能力。

sentences.en: If they are still able to govern the Gaza Strip after the war ends, or if the ceasefire becomes a permanent one, then that would represent something of a victory for the group,
sentences.zh: 如果他们在战争结束后仍能治理加沙地带，或者如果停火成为永久停火，那么这将代表该组织某种程度上的胜利，

sentences.en: even if their actions have resulted in the decimation of the territory that they controlled before the war began.
sentences.zh: 即使他们的行动导致了他们在战争开始前所控制的领土被彻底摧毁。

sentences.en: So, to that point, what about Israel?
sentences.zh: 那么，说到这一点，以色列呢？

sentences.en: What does this deal mean for Israel?
sentences.zh: 这项协议对以色列意味着什么？

sentences.en: In the short term, it brings also some respite, also some joy, to an Israeli society that has been traumatized both by the October 7th attacks,
sentences.zh: 短期来看，这给以色列社会带来了一些喘息的机会，也带来了一些喜悦，因为以色列社会不仅因10月7日的袭击而受到创伤，

sentences.en: which were the deadliest attacks on Israel in its history, but also by the 466 days since in which Israelis have been torn by guilt and sadness over the continued incarceration
sentences.zh: 那是有史以来以色列遭遇的最致命袭击，而且在随后的466天里，以色列人一直因他们的亲友被关押在加沙而饱受内疚和悲伤的折磨，

sentences.en: of their friends, relatives in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这种折磨也让他们深受创伤。

sentences.en: And if at least some of those hostages can be released, it counts as a kind of redemption, not only for the hostages themselves, but for Israelis across the political spectrum.
sentences.zh: 如果至少能释放其中一部分人质，这不仅对人质本身，对整个政治光谱的以色列人来说，都算是一种救赎。

sentences.en: Longer term, if the deal holds and Netanyahu decides to continue it and to nudge it towards something permanent, then it could severely destabilize his own coalition government.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，如果协议能够维持，内塔尼亚胡决定继续推进并将其引向某种永久性的解决方案，那么这可能会严重动摇他自己的联合政府。

sentences.en: He is in power, in part through the support of several far-right ministers and lawmakers who deeply oppose ending the war with Hamas still in power, even if that means
sentences.zh: 他之所以能掌权，部分得益于几位极右翼部长和议员的支持，他们强烈反对在哈马斯仍掌权的情况下结束战争，即使这意味着

sentences.en: leaving some hostages inside Gaza.
sentences.zh: 要将一些人质留在加沙。

sentences.en: So if he does agree to take this from a six-week deal into a longer arrangement, they could leave his coalition potentially destabilizing it or maybe even collapsing it,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果他确实同意将这份为期六周的协议转化为更长期的安排，他们可能会退出他的联盟，从而可能导致联盟动摇，甚至崩溃，

sentences.en: which could lead to early elections and perhaps, depending on the results of those elections, a transition of power within Israeli society.
sentences.zh: 这可能会导致提前选举，并可能根据选举结果，引发以色列社会内部的权力更迭。

sentences.en: So short term, this brings relief and joy for Israelis as well as people in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 所以短期内，这给以色列人和加沙民众都带来了宽慰和喜悦。

sentences.en: In the long term, it could deepen some of the divides that we've seen split Israeli society for many different reasons in recent years.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，这可能会加剧近年来因各种原因导致以色列社会分裂的一些分歧。

sentences.en: You said that one of the reasons we're here in this moment talking about a ceasefire now is because Israel is actually in a stronger position today.
sentences.zh: 你说我们现在之所以谈论停火，原因之一是以色列今天实际上处于更有利的地位。

sentences.en: And it makes me wonder about its position in the broader region.
sentences.zh: 这让我对它在更广泛地区的位置感到好奇。

sentences.en: You know, as you said, a lot of Hamas's allies have been weakened.
sentences.zh: 你知道，正如你所说，哈马斯的许多盟友都已被削弱。

sentences.en: So do you think that through this war,
sentences.zh: 那么你认为通过这场战争，

sentences.en: Israel is ultimately in a more powerful position now in the region?
sentences.zh: 以色列现在在地区内是否处于更强大的地位？

sentences.en: Yes and no.
sentences.zh: 既是，也不是。

sentences.en: In reputational terms,
sentences.zh: 从声誉角度来看，

sentences.en: Israel has dealt itself damaged by the way it has been perceived to conduct this war.
sentences.zh: 以色列因其被认为进行这场战争的方式而损害了自己的形象。

sentences.en: It is accused of genocide at the International Court of Justice.
sentences.zh: 它在国际法院被指控犯有种族灭绝罪。

sentences.en: Prime Minister Netanyahu, as well as his former defence minister,
sentences.zh: 总理内塔尼亚胡以及他的前国防部长，

sentences.en: Joab Gallant, are wanted for war crimes by the International Criminal Court.
sentences.zh: 约阿夫·加兰特，因战争罪被国际刑事法院通缉。

sentences.en: There has been criticism of Israel almost like never before as a result of the way it's conducted its war in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 由于其在加沙进行战争的方式，以色列受到了前所未有的批评。

sentences.en: And in that sense, you could argue it has lost or it has at least lost ground in a diplomatic war, a war for legitimacy and a war for reputation.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，你可以说它已经输了，或者至少在外交战、合法性之战和声誉之战中失去了阵地。

sentences.en: But is that important to Israel at all?
sentences.zh: 但这对以色列来说重要吗？

sentences.en: I mean, the diplomacy, you know, okay, there's the reputation, but it's not fundamentally related to its power in the region and winning, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，外交，你知道，好吧，有声誉问题，但这与它在地区内的权力和获胜没有根本联系，对吧？

sentences.en: So Israel depends on international support for at least some of its actions.
sentences.zh: 以色列的某些行动确实依赖于国际支持。

sentences.en: It depends on American funds and American military resources, ammunition, fighter jets, in order to wage its wars.
sentences.zh: 它依赖美国的资金和美国的军事资源、弹药、战斗机来发动战争。

sentences.en: And within the Middle East, it depends on good relations with the Arab world in order to cement its long-term status within the region.
sentences.zh: 而在中东内部，它依赖与阿拉伯世界的良好关系来巩固其在地区内的长期地位。

sentences.en: Before the war,
sentences.zh: 战争之前，

sentences.en: Israel was close to forging a landmark diplomatic deal between itself and Saudi Arabia, the most influential country in the Arab world.
sentences.zh: 以色列即将与阿拉伯世界最具影响力的国家沙特阿拉伯达成一项具有里程碑意义的外交协议。

sentences.en: The war put those negotiations on ice and in fact made it much harder for Saudi Arabia to be seen to be doing a deal with a country that many people in the Arab world believe
sentences.zh: 战争使这些谈判陷入停滞，事实上，这使得沙特阿拉伯更难被视为与一个许多阿拉伯世界民众认为

sentences.en: is committing a genocide against Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 正在对巴勒斯坦人进行种族灭绝的国家达成协议。

sentences.en: And if the war ends,
sentences.zh: 如果战争结束，

sentences.en: Israelis will hope that they can get those negotiations back on track.
sentences.zh: 以色列人会希望他们能让这些谈判重回正轨。

sentences.en: But militarily, yes, as you say,
sentences.zh: 但在军事上，是的，正如你所说，

sentences.en: Israel has weakened Hamas, they've weakened Hezbollah, they have weakened Iran, and all of those battles contributed at least in some part to the collapse of Iran's ally,
sentences.zh: 以色列削弱了哈马斯，削弱了真主党，削弱了伊朗，所有这些战斗至少在一定程度上促成了伊朗盟友——叙利亚政府的垮台。

sentences.en: the Syrian government.
sentences.zh: 叙利亚政府。

sentences.en: And so Israel, despite all its internal divisions, has proved itself as the region's strongest military power.
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管存在所有内部纷争，以色列还是证明了自己是该地区最强大的军事力量。

sentences.en: It means, or at least Israelis will hope it means, whatever reputational loss
sentences.zh: 这意味着，或者至少以色列人会希望这意味着，无论以色列因其在加沙的战争行为而在中东和全球遭受了怎样的声誉损失，

sentences.en: Israel has suffered because of the conduct of its war in Gaza, both in the Middle East and across the world, it is simply too powerful militarily to be wished away.
sentences.zh: 它在军事上都太强大了，无法被忽视。

sentences.en: And that whatever the anger many people within the Middle East feel towards Israel, their leaders will feel that Israel is a country that they have to work with
sentences.zh: 而且，无论中东许多人对以色列感到多么愤怒，他们的领导人都会觉得以色列是一个他们必须合作的国家，

sentences.en: precisely because it is such a military force.
sentences.zh: 恰恰因为它拥有如此强大的军事力量。

sentences.en: Patrick, thank you.
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: On Thursday, last-minute disputes delayed a vote by Israel's cabinet that would ratify the ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 周四，最后一刻的争议推迟了以色列内阁批准停火协议的投票。

sentences.en: Netanyahu's office accused Hamas of reneging on parts of it, a charge that Hamas denied.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡办公室指责哈马斯违背了协议的部分内容，哈马斯否认了这一指控。

sentences.en: Despite the last-minute wrangling, the agreement is expected to eventually take effect.
sentences.zh: 尽管最后一刻出现了争执，但该协议预计最终仍将生效。

sentences.en: It will begin on Sunday with Hamas releasing some hostages in exchange for Palestinian prisoners.
sentences.zh: 协议将于周日开始，哈马斯将释放部分人质以换取巴勒斯坦囚犯。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该知道的消息。

sentences.en: On a busy day of confirmation hearings for Donald Trump's cabinet, his pick for Attorney General
sentences.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普内阁确认听证会忙碌的一天里，他提名的司法部长人选

sentences.en: Pam Bondi faced tough questions from Democrats about whether she could stand up to the president-elect and operate independently from him.
sentences.zh: 帕姆·邦迪面临民主党人的严厉质询，内容是她是否能顶住当选总统的压力并独立于他运作。

sentences.en: So my questions now are can you tell our truth to the president?
sentences.zh: 所以我现在的问题是，你能对总统说真话吗？

sentences.en: So let me start with an easy truth that you could speak to the president.
sentences.zh: 那么让我从一个你可以对总统说的简单事实开始。

sentences.en: Can you tell us, can you tell him that Donald Trump lost the 2020 election?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们，你能告诉他唐纳德·特朗普输掉了2020年大选吗？

sentences.en: Can you say that?
sentences.zh: 你能说出来吗？

sentences.en: Do you have the independents to say that?
sentences.zh: 你有独立性说出这一点吗？

sentences.en: Do you have the gravitas, the stature, the intestinal fortitude to say,
sentences.zh: 你有那种庄重、地位和胆识去说，

sentences.en: Donald Trump, you lost the 2020 election?
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普，你输掉了2020年大选吗？

sentences.en: Can you tell us that here today?
sentences.zh: 你今天能在这里告诉我们吗？

sentences.en: Senator, what I can tell you is I will never play politics.
sentences.zh: 参议员，我能告诉你的是，我永远不会玩弄政治。

sentences.en: You're trying to engage me in a gotcha.
sentences.zh: 你是在试图诱导我掉进陷阱。

sentences.en: I won't do it.
sentences.zh: 我不会那样做。

sentences.en: Bondi repeatedly dodged questions about whether she agreed with
sentences.zh: 邦迪一再回避关于她是否同意

sentences.en: Donald Trump's false claim that the 2020 election was stolen and whether she would support his plan to pardon
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普关于2020年大选被窃取的虚假说法，以及她是否会支持他赦免

sentences.en: January 6 rioters.
sentences.zh: 1月6日骚乱者的计划的问题。

sentences.en: are the felons convicted of breaking into the Capitol on January 6th hostages or patriots as President-elect
sentences.zh: 那些因闯入国会大厦而被定罪的重罪犯是人质还是爱国者，正如当选总统

sentences.en: Trump has said repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 特朗普一再声称的那样。

sentences.en: Do you agree with his characterization of the felons that I refer to?
sentences.zh: 你同意他对我所指的那些重罪犯的定性吗？

sentences.en: I am not familiar with that statement,
sentences.zh: 我不熟悉那个声明，

sentences.en: Senator.
sentences.zh: 参议员。

sentences.en: I just familiarized you with that statement.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚让你熟悉了那个声明。

sentences.en: Do you agree with that statement?
sentences.zh: 你同意那个声明吗？

sentences.en: I'm not familiar with it,
sentences.zh: 我不熟悉它，

sentences.en: Senator.
sentences.zh: 参议员。

sentences.en: Bondi is expected to be confirmed in the coming days.
sentences.zh: 邦迪预计将在未来几天内获得确认。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: Today, an oligarchy is taking shape in America of extreme wealth, power, and influence that literally threatens our entire democracy, our basic rights and freedoms,
sentences.zh: 今天，美国正在形成一种极端财富、权力和影响力的寡头政治，这实际上威胁到了我们整个民主制度、我们的基本权利和自由，

sentences.en: and a fair shot for everyone to get ahead.
sentences.zh: 以及每个人获得成功的公平机会。

sentences.en: Speaking to the
sentences.zh: 在周一离任前最后一次向

sentences.en: American public for the final time before departing office on Monday,
sentences.zh: 美国公众发表讲话时，

sentences.en: President Joe Biden described what he said were his gravest concerns before receding into life as a private citizen.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登总统描述了他所说的在回归平民生活之前他最深切的担忧。

sentences.en: Americans are being buried under an avalanche of misinformation and disinformation enabling the abuse of power.
sentences.zh: 美国人正被淹没在错误信息和虚假信息的雪崩中，这助长了权力的滥用。

sentences.en: In a clear rebuke of Meta's decision to end its fact-checking program,
sentences.zh: 在明确批评Meta决定终止其事实核查项目时，

sentences.en: Biden warned of a, quote, tech-industrial complex that he said is overwhelming
sentences.zh: 拜登警告称存在一个他所说的“科技工业复合体”，他说这正在压倒

sentences.en: Americans and called the country to, quote, hold social media platforms accountable.
sentences.zh: 美国人，并呼吁国家“追究社交媒体平台的责任”。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由斯特拉·谭、

sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·斯特恩和穆吉·扎迪制作，米歇尔·邦贾提供了帮助。

sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.zh: 本周在

sentences.zh: 《Wirecutter秀》上，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线，因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
